name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
headline: F1 The House of Assembly publishes only one-page lists of each year's Acts, not the Acts
registry_correction: Registry 'Income Tax Act; ECCU' unverified: the House of Assembly's annual lists name the Income Tax Act 2009 and Income Tax (Amendment) Acts No. 5 of 2019 and No. 20 of 2020, but no text was reached.

routes: Internet Archive CDX of finance.gov.vc found its 'PDF/Acts' folder; the live site serves Cap. 435 Income Tax Act (Revised Edition 2009, 159 pages, text layer), Income Tax (Amendment) Acts No. 5 of 2019 and No. 20 of 2020 (territorial basis, withholding), and Finance Act No. 10 of 2023 (s. 47(1)(b) allowance raised to 22,000 dollars; Fifth Schedule 'On $10,001 - $30,000' 30 % -> 28 %): saved in vc/law/rescue/ (scans OCR'd)

House of Assembly annual lists 2010-2025 (live and archived) show a Finance Act every year 2010-2024 amending 'the laws contained in' the Finance Act; their texts (except 2023) were not reached, so the rest of the 2025 Fifth Schedule (first bands, top rate) and allowances cannot be established
finance.gov.vc and ird.gov.vc 'tax tables' (2018-2024) are withholding tables (referees): Tax_Tables-2024 downloaded, not opened
rescue.unlock: the Finance Acts 2010-2022 and 2024 (or a consolidation of Cap. 435 after 2009); with them the model is a short step from Cap. 435 + Finance Act 2023

routes: legal.gov.vc (Attorney General's Chambers; found by WebSearch): Official Gazettes 2016-2026 (2024: 72 issues downloaded on the laptop): No. 10 lists S.R.&O. No. 4 of 2024 (Provisional Collection of Taxes Order 2024), No. 11 S.R.&O. No. 6 of 2024, No. 24 Act No. 6 of 2024 (Finance Act 2024): the gazette prints the notices only ('can be purchased at the Government Printing Office'), not the texts

ird.gov.vc (laptop): legislation page = the same files as pass 1; 'Standard Deduction' page: 2025 25,000, 2024 25,000, 2023 22,000, 2022-2018 20,000 (official secondary; consistent with Finance Act 2023 s. 47(1)(b)); PIT 'current rate' links only to the 2024 tax tables (referee, not opened)
finance.gov.vc forms: 2021 return form prints the allowances (personal 1,200, spouse 700, child 400, standard deduction 20,000) but no rate schedule; 2023 form 404
Wayback CDX of finance.gov.vc, ird.gov.vc, assembly.gov.vc, pmoffice.gov.vc, gov.vc: budget addresses (proposals) and annual act lists; no Finance Act 2010-2022 or 2024 text
two WebSearches: no host of the Finance Acts or a consolidated Fifth Schedule
Cap. 435 (2009 RE) Fifth Schedule itself prints three conflicting 'Over $45,000' lines (40 %, 32.5 %, 40 % 'with effect from income year 1996'): recorded as a finding
